comments.author: Frost428
comments.body_html:
Strange. I was building the SVD in-game earlier and I noticed that the wood stock have distinctly different recoil than the black and green one. I think the overexaggerated numbers are because I was looking at it when compared to the buffer tube adapter. When compared to the other polymer stocks, it seems like the wood stocks have the +/- recoil as you mentioned, but the polymer and green ones have + recoil for both parts.

I just checked again and the wooden stock have a +5/+5 recoil, the two polymer ones have a +2/+8, and the buffer tube adapter by itself has -10/+3. So the end result is the conventional stocks have the flat + recoil, while the adapter is the only one with like -60/-20 something recoil when stacked with the AR stocks and grips, which seems wildly out of balance to me.

Hope this helps.

comments.body_html: does this weapon have a globals preset? still trying to figure out why this series of gun mods (wtt gun mods) are causing crashes with the shiny weapons airdrop mod (freezes the game when pulling a wtt weapon). just looking for solid answers here

comments.author: Tron
comments.body_html:
It’s not shiny weapons airdrop mod. One of our weapon designers actually runs that mod currently. Also, our weapons do have global presets. A clear sign that a weapon doesn’t have a global preset is when you check it on the flea market and it’s just the base frame of the weapon without attachments.

There must be another mod conflicting.

comments.author: Rexana
comments.body_html: What do you mean by “pulling a wtt weapon”. are you moving it around in your stash or you found one in an airdrop

comments.author: rubenthekid
comments.body_html: alright so i just ran into the same issue after opening up one of the sealed cases without any of the wtt mods in the config for shiny weapons, so it indeed isnt these mods or the shiny weapons mod (because i added more vanilla weapons to the list besides just the wtt weapons). unfortunately i cannot find the source of the issue, only that theres an error somewhere.

comments.author: Rexana
comments.body_html:
if the freeze/crash happened without any WTT mods installed, then i’m pretty sure it’s not WTT mods causing the issue.

What list are you adding things to. are you changing the list of weapons you can get from the weapons cases? because if so, don’t do that. Shiny probably has special presets made and adds those presets to the weapon list.

I’m running 118 server mods, which include Shiny’s and WTT guns. i have not experienced the issue you are having and i also have not modified the sealed weapon cases loot list. my suggestion would be to rollback whatever you did and/or re-install shiny weapons.

comments.author: rubenthekid
comments.body_html:
Shiny explicitly stated in the description that you can add weapons to the list in the config, and said modded guns can potentially work so long as they have a global preset (wtt guns indeed have a global preset). So no, modifying the list itself wasnt the issue, the problem i believe was that i added pump action shotguns to the semi shotguns list (there isnt a separate list for pumpies).

Shiny’s mod is very modular, you yourself should take a look into the json file and youll see what i mean.
